'''Ellé''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] who served as one of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaidens]] at the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
[[File:Elle-SWcom.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ellé]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Ellé served with her fellow [[Handmaiden/Legends|handmaiden]], [[Moteé/Legends|Moteé]]. She was one of the select few who knew of [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala's]] secret [[Wedding of Anakin Skywalker and Padmé Amidala/Legends|marriage]] to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].<ref name="DB" />

Immediately after the proclamation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Moteé/Legends|Moteé]] and Ellé accompanied Padmé Amidala to her suite. [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]] left them.<ref name="Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (novelization)]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Ellé was portrayed by Australian actress [[Chantal Freer]] in a deleted scene of [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="SWI71">{{InsiderCite|71|Prequel Update}}</ref>
